claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for anemia (hemoglobin 8.2-9.5 g/dL) in the setting of critical illness and ongoing hemodynamic support.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation (SpO2 92-96%).
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring (arterial line, PA catheter, CVP) and titrate vasoactive infusions to maintain MAP ≥65 mmHg.
Monitor and manage temporary pacemaker settings, ensuring appropriate rate and sensing/stimulation thresholds.
Obtain daily chest radiograph to assess lines, tubes, and pulmonary status.
Check complete blood count and coagulation panel to monitor anemia and coagulopathy.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, targeting mild pain control.
Perform delirium screening (CAM-ICU) and orient patient as appropriate.
Implement VTE prophylaxis with pharmacologic or mechanical methods as appropriate.
Maintain glycemic control with insulin infusion, targeting glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
